name: cyrius-lsp
description: Cyrius language server wiring for Claude Code. Auto-attaches cyrius-lsp to every .cyr-family file (.cyr, .tcyr, .bcyr, .fcyr, .scyr, .smcyr) — diagnostics from the cycc compiler through the cyrius CLI, plus hover, go-to-definition, references, document symbols and semantic tokens — and finds the server even when ~/.cyrius/bin is not on Claude Code's PATH.
